questions.stem: Which of the following criteria is diagnostic of acute kidney injury in a patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Rise in creatinine 1.5 times the baseline value within 7 days

options.label: B
options.text: Rise in creatinine ≥ 0.3mg/dl from baseline within 7 days

options.label: C
options.text: Rise in creatinine ≥ 0.5 mg/dl from baseline within 48 hours
